name: Chuck Edwards

accounts.evidence: The official House site links its X/Twitter icon to twitter.com/RepChuckEdwards.
The campaign website links twitter.com/ChuckEdwards4NC in its header and footer social links.

notes: The official site's embedded feed still has the leftover link text 'Tweets by RepEdwards', but its href points to RepChuckEdwards. That fits the hint that @RepEdwards no longer works (the account was probably renamed).

name: Christopher H. Smith
notes: No X account found. chrissmith.house.gov links only YouTube and Instagram, and the campaign site smith4nj.com links only Facebook and YouTube. An American Israelite article from 26 March 2026 (https://americanisraelite.com/all-about-deception-says-nj-republican-who-cant-get-x-to-remove-handle/), reprinted from JNS, says 'Smith is not on the social media site' and that he shut down his Twitter page in January 2021. His old handle was @RepChrisSmith, seen in 2018 archive snapshots. A search snippet names ChrisSmithNJCD4 as the PARODY account that impersonates him. It is not his account and must not be used.

name: Nellie Pou

accounts.evidence: The official House site links x.com/RepNellie in its header and footer social icons and in its embedded X feed.
The campaign website, paid for by Nellie Pou for Congress, links x.com/NelliePou.

notes: The handle on file, @caohouse, belongs to the House Chief Administrative Officer, not to Pou. It was a wrong match, not a renamed account.

name: Analilia Mejia

accounts.evidence: The official House site links x.com/RepAnalilia in its header and footer icons, its X section and its Follow links.
The Nation's author page for her, which describes her as the Member of Congress for NJ-11, links twitter.com/Analilia_Mejia.

notes: I did not find a campaign website, so @Analilia_Mejia may also serve as her campaign account. Ballotpedia returned an empty page. One of the three allowed web searches was left unused.

name: Nicole Malliotakis

accounts.evidence: The official House site links x.com/RepNicole twice.

notes: The handle on file, @RepMalliotakis, did not work. Her official site now links @RepNicole, which is probably the renamed account or a replacement.
